t2.title: Students have part-time jobs while studying
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should students have part-time jobs while studying?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
What a great discussion! As someone who's been learning photography, I have strong views on this.

Undoubtedly, skill matters far more than equipment. A skilled photographer with a smartphone can capture better images than a beginner with a $5,000 camera.

Firstly, photography is about understanding light, composition, and timing. These are learned skills, not something you can buy.

Moreover, constraints can actually boost creativity. Working with limited equipment forces you to think more creatively about problem-solving.

However, equipment does matter at advanced levels. Professional work often requires specialized gear for specific situations.

Additionally, better equipment can make the learning process easier and more enjoyable.

My advice: master the basics with whatever you have before investing in expensive gear. The camera doesn't take the photo – you do!

What equipment do you use?
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
The class is good. I like photos. Teacher is nice. Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello,
I like the photography workshop. It was good. The teacher was good and the practical was fun. But the cameras were not very good. I want to learn about taking photos of animals next time. Thank you.
t2.sampleB1:
Hi,
I really enjoyed the photography workshop! I thought the teaching was good, and the practical sessions were very helpful. However, some of the equipment wasn't great. A few of the cameras didn't work properly. I think it would be good to have some newer cameras next time.

In the future, I'd like to learn more about portrait photography. I'm also interested in learning about how to edit photos using software like Photoshop. Overall, it was a great workshop, and I learned a lot. Thanks!
t2.sampleB2: Great topic — this is something I've thought about a lot! In my opinion, students should definitely take on a part-time job while studying, as long as they don't overdo it. Working a few hours a week teaches you skills that you simply can't pick up in a classroom, like managing your time and dealing with all sorts of people. On top of that, having your own money makes a huge difference. Instead of relying on your parents for everything, you learn to budget and stand on your own two feet. My cousin, for example, worked in a café during university and it really boosted her confidence. That said, there is a limit. If a job starts eating into your study time, your grades are bound to suffer, and that defeats the whole point of being at university. At the end of the day, it comes down to balance. A part-time job can be a brilliant experience, but studies have to come first. What do you all think? Has anyone here juggled work and studying? I'd love to hear your stories!
t2.uzSample:
Qanday ajoyib muhokama! Fotografiyani o'rganayotgan odam sifatida, bu borada mening qat'iy fikrlarim bor.

Shubhasiz, mahorat uskunadan ko'ra ancha muhim. Smartfonga ega bo'lgan mahoratli fotograf 5000 dollarlik kameraga ega bo'lgan yangi boshlovchiga qaraganda yaxshiroq suratga olishi mumkin.

Birinchidan, fotografiya yorug'likni, kompozitsiyani va vaqtni tushunish haqida. Bular sotib olish mumkin bo'lgan narsa emas, balki o'rganilgan ko'nikmalardir.

Bundan tashqari, cheklovlar aslida ijodkorlikni oshirishi mumkin. Cheklangan uskunalar bilan ishlash sizni muammolarni hal qilish haqida ko'proq ijodiy fikrlashga majbur qiladi.

Biroq, uskunalar ilg'or darajalarda ahamiyatga ega. Professional ish ko'pincha muayyan vaziyatlar uchun maxsus jihozlarni talab qiladi.

Bundan tashqari, yaxshiroq uskunalar o'rganish jarayonini osonroq va qiziqarliroq qilishi mumkin.

Mening maslahatim: qimmatbaho jihozlarga sarmoya kiritishdan oldin, qo'lingizda bor narsa bilan asoslarni o'zlashtiring. Suratni kamera emas, siz olasiz!

Siz qanday uskunadan foydalanasiz?
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Sinf yaxshi. Menga rasmlar yoqadi. O'qituvchi yaxshi. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,
Menga fotosurat ustaxonasi yoqdi. Yaxshi bo'ldi. O'qituvchi yaxshi edi va amaliy mashg'ulot qiziqarli bo'ldi. Lekin kameralar juda yaxshi emas edi. Keyingi safar hayvonlarning suratlarini olishni o'rganmoqchiman. Rahmat.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Salom,
Fotografiya bo'yicha seminar menga juda yoqdi! O'qitish yaxshi deb o'yladim va amaliy mashg'ulotlar juda foydali bo'ldi. Biroq, ba'zi uskunalar unchalik yaxshi emas edi. Bir nechta kameralar yaxshi ishlamadi. O'ylashimcha, keyingi safar yangiroq kameralar bo'lishi yaxshi bo'lardi.

Kelajakda men portret fotografiyasi haqida ko'proq bilishni xohlayman. Shuningdek, Photoshop kabi dasturlar yordamida fotosuratlarni qanday tahrirlashni o'rganishga qiziqaman. Umuman olganda, bu ajoyib seminar bo'ldi va men ko'p narsalarni o'rgandim. Rahmat!
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli Creative Lens Academy,

Yaxshi tuzilgan va qiziqarli fotosuratlar bo'yicha seminar uchun rahmat. O'qitish sifati umuman yuqori ekanligini aniqladim, o'qituvchi mavzuga aniq ishtiyoq ko'rsatdi. Amaliy mashg'ulotlar bebaho bo'lib, nazariy tushunchalarni mustahkamlagan amaliy tajriba berdi. Biroq, taqdim etilgan uskunalar har xil edi. Ba'zi kameralar a'lo holatda bo'lsa, boshqalari aniq eskirgan va ta'mirlash yoki almashtirishga muhtoj edi. Bu nomutanosiblik umumiy tajribani biroz buzdi.

Kelajakdagi seminarlarga kelsak, men ayniqsa kompozitsiyaning ilg'or usullariga qaratilgan kursga qiziqardim, ehtimol mavhum fotosurat yoki uzoq muddatli ekspozitsiya usullarini o'rganish. Bundan tashqari, fotosuratning axloqiy jihatlariga, ayniqsa ko'cha fotosurati va fotojurnalistikada bag'ishlangan sessiya qimmatli qo'shimcha bo'ladi. Yana bir bor rag'batlantiruvchi dam olish kunlari uchun rahmat.

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the photography academy. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample:
Dear Creative Lens Academy,

Thank you for a truly inspiring weekend. The workshop greatly improved my photography skills.

Firstly, the instructor was exceptional. Complex techniques were explained in an accessible way, and the hands-on practice reinforced the theory.

However, I have some suggestions. The group size was rather large, limiting individual attention. Smaller groups would allow more personalized feedback.

Additionally, providing follow-up resources like video tutorials would help participants continue learning at home.

Furthermore, offering advanced workshops for returning students would be greatly appreciated.

I will definitely recommend your academy to fellow photography enthusiasts.

With gratitude,
An Aspiring Photographer
t12.sampleA1:
Hi Creative Lens!

Thank you. Good class. Teacher good. Camera okay. I like photos. Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Dear Creative Lens Academy,

Thank you for the class. It was good. The teacher was nice and I learned some things. The cameras were okay, but some were old. I want to learn about taking photos of animals next time. I like taking photos. Thank you.

Bye,

Me
t12.sampleB1:
Dear Creative Lens Academy,

Thank you for the photography workshop. I enjoyed it very much. I think the teacher was very good and explained things clearly. The practical sessions were also helpful because we could try out what we learned.

However, I think the equipment could be better. Some of the cameras were quite old. Also, I would like to see a workshop about taking photos at night in the future. I think that would be interesting.

Overall, it was a good experience and I would recommend it to others.

Sincerely,

A Participant
t12.sampleB2: Dear Creative Lens Academy, I am writing to share my feedback following the weekend photography workshop I recently attended. On the whole, I was thoroughly impressed. The teaching quality was excellent, and the instructor explained tricky concepts in a way that was easy to follow. The practical sessions were the highlight, as they gave us plenty of hands-on experience. That said, I feel the equipment let the course down slightly. Several of the cameras were outdated, which made it hard to keep up during the exercises, so I would strongly recommend investing in newer models. For future workshops, I would love to see a session on night photography, as I think many participants would find it both challenging and rewarding. Thank you for a memorable weekend. Yours faithfully, Bekzod Aliyev
t12.uzSample:

Biroq, mening ba'zi takliflarim bor. Guruh hajmi juda katta edi, bu esa har bir ishtirokchiga yetarlicha e'tibor berishni chekladi. Kichikroq guruhlar shaxsiy fikr-mulohazalarni ko'proq olish imkonini beradi.

Bundan tashqari, video darsliklar kabi qo'shimcha manbalarni taqdim etish ishtirokchilarga uyda o'qishni davom ettirishga yordam beradi.

Shuningdek, qaytib kelgan talabalar uchun ilg'or seminarlar taklif qilish juda mamnuniyat bilan qabul qilinadi.

Men sizning akademiyangizni boshqa fotografiya ixlosmandlariga albatta tavsiya qilaman.

Minatdorchilik bilan,
Intiluvchan Fotograf

Biroq, menimcha, uskunalar yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin edi. Ba'zi kameralar ancha eski edi. Shuningdek, kelajakda tunda suratga olish bo'yicha seminar bo'lishini xohlardim. Menimcha, bu qiziqarli bo'lardi.

Yaqinda bo'lib o'tgan fotosuratlar bo'yicha seminar uchun rahmat. Men uni fotosurat texnikasi haqidagi tushunchamni sezilarli darajada yaxshilagan qimmatli tajriba deb topdim.

Ayniqsa, o'qituvchining murakkab tushunchalarni aniq va qiziqarli tarzda yetkazish qobiliyati meni hayratga soldi. Amaliy mashg'ulotlar ham foydali bo'ldi, biz o'rgangan nazariyani qo'llash uchun yetarli imkoniyat yaratdi.

Shunga qaramay, men yaxshilash mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar bor deb hisoblayman. Birinchidan, mavjud uskunalar assortimenti kengaytirilishi mumkin. Asosiy narsalar qamrab olingan bo'lsa-da, yanada ixtisoslashgan linzalar va aksessuarlarga kirish o'rganish tajribasini yaxshilaydi. Ikkinchidan, men kelajakda portret fotosuratiga, xususan, tabiiy va haqiqiy ifodalarni suratga olish texnikasiga qaratilgan seminarda qatnashishdan manfaatdor bo'lardim.

Umuman olganda, men seminardan juda mamnun bo'ldim va albatta sizning akademiyangiz tomonidan tashkil etilgan kelajakdagi tadbirlarda qatnashishni o'ylab ko'raman.

Hurmat bilan,

Qoniqish hosil qilgan ishtirokchi
